dct_description_sm: This dataset was generated to study transport and reactivity of the terrestrial dissolved organic matter from the Mackenzie river in the Beaufort sea.  It includes DOM reactivity to light along the transition from freshwater to saltwater.  Photobleaching experiments to establish photoreactivity of fresh water and marine water end members, to determine the wave length depende ncy of photobleaching and in samples within the Mackenzie plume and to determine rates of photobleaching in river and fresh-salt transition zone.
dct_title_s: Dissolved organic matter (including lignin and photoreactivity) transects of the Mackenzie River, Beaufort Sea (ARDEX)
